source: ProtoTrack indexes (sets, named gear, named weapons, exotics, gear talents, weapon talents, prototype stats) checked 2026-11-01, cross-checked against the Division 2 Community Data Hub CSVs (https://github.com/div2hub/game-data, CC BY 4.0), which ProtoTrack cites for base weapon stats and attribute caps. shd.gg was behind Cloudflare and was not fetched. Numbers are stored only where one of those sources states them.

items.name: Aces & Eights
items.talentText:
Flip a card when landing shots with a Rifle or Marksman Rifle.
After 5 cards are flipped, the damage of your next shot is amplified by 75% . More shots are enhanced the better the hand revealed.
Four of a Kind: 4 shots.
Full House: 3 shots.
Aces and Eights: 2 shots.
Flip an additional card on headshots.
items.chestText: Increases Dead Man's Hand damage bonus from 75% to 100% .
items.backpackText: Amplifies 1 extra shot when revealing your hand.
items.pvp: 2 10% Marksman Rifle Damage 2 14% Rifle Damage 3 14% Headshot Damage 3 15% Weapon Handling

items.name: Aegis
items.talentText:
Get +4% Damage Resistance for every enemy that is Targeting you. Max stack is 8.
The bonus is Multiplied by 1.X, Where X is the number of agents in your group.
items.chestText: Enemies targeting your Decoy also count towards the Stoic Damage Resistance Bonus.
items.backpackText: Increase Stoic Damage Resistance bonus from 4% to 5% .
items.pvp: 2 100% Health 3 21% Total Armor

items.name: Breaking Point
items.talentText:
Hitting a shot with a Rifle or MMR grants a stack.
The maximum stack count equals the weapon's magazine size.
Reloading grants +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack for 20 seconds.
No stacks are acquired while the bonuses are active. The timer running out refills your magazine.
Switching weapons while the bonuses are active stops the effect and refills your magazine.
Switching weapons while the bonuses are not active removes all stacks and refills your magazine.
items.chestText: Increases On Point timer from 20s to 40s.
items.backpackText: Increases On Point Weapon Damage bonus from 4% to 9% per stack.
items.pvp: 2 14% Rifle Damage 2 10% Marksman Rifle Damage 3 14% Headshot Damage 3 15% Weapon Handling

items.name: Cavalier
items.talentText:
Charging:
For each second spent out of cover during combat Agents will get 5% reduced incoming skill damage. Max 50% .
Charged:
While fully charged, gain immunity to any movement speed debuff and share hazard protection and damage reduction with all allies for 10 seconds.
After Charged is consumed, Charging buff will resume if the Agent is still in combat and out of cover. Charged Talent does not stack.
If another agent applies Charged on an ongoing Charging Talent, Charging will pause for the duration of the Charged Talent.
items.chestText: Increases Charger max incoming damage protection to 70%
items.backpackText: Charger gives 10% protection per second

items.name: Umbra Initiative
items.talentText:
From the Shadows:
While in cover, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50.
Each stack will give 1% Critical damage increase and 0.3% RPM. Buff does not apply while shooting from cover.
While out of cover you lose 2 stacks per second at normal speed and 1 stack per second if sprinting.
Into the Light:
While out of cover and in combat, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50.
Each stack will give 0.8% Armor regen when it is consumed.
Stacks consume, 10 stacks per second, only in cover.
items.chestText: Increases max stacks for From the Shadows from 50 to 100 and stack gain from 10 to 20.
items.backpackText: Increases max stacks for Into the Light from 50 to 100, stack gain from 10 to 20 and stack consumption from 10 to 20

Killing an enemy within 25m will provide 40% Weapon Damage to MMR's and Rifles, 20% Weapon Damage to AR's and LMG's and 30% Headshot Damage for 15s.
Internittently killing enemies from both ranges will build stacks. At 4 stacks, all bonuses are multiplied by 2 and triggered at the same time for 15s. No stacks are acquired while these bonuses are active.
